issues.legal_issue: Eviction of an occupant for unauthorised non-agricultural use of agricultural land includes removal of unauthorised structures, and the revenue authority may remove those structures without being liable in damages.
material_facts: The occupant held unalienated land for agricultural use and erected structures without obtaining the required permission.
The occupant was lawfully evicted after failing to comply with a notice to remove the unauthorised structures.
The revenue authority demolished some of the structures, and the occupant obtained a decree for damages and an injunction.
The State appealed from the decree concerning the demolition and damages.
issues.conclusion: The eviction required the land to be vacated, including removal of the unauthorised structures. The authority to remove them was incidental and ancillary to the power to evict, so the authority was not liable in damages for the demolition. The appeal was allowed and the decree was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 65 and 66 of the Bombay Land Revenue Code, an occupant of agricultural land may not change its use to a non-agricultural purpose without permission, and unauthorised changed use permits summary eviction. Section 202 provides for eviction by requiring the land to be vacated. Read together, these provisions mean that eviction and vacation are not merely the occupant’s physical removal: the unauthorised structures must also be removed so the land can be restored to its permitted use. The power to remove those structures is incidental and ancillary to the power to evict and obtain vacation. Sections 40, 41, 68 and 69 also inform the limited nature of the occupant’s rights. The Court referred to the different wording of section 61 but did not rely on any earlier case.

rule.if: appeal_from_demolition_damages_decree and agricultural_land_held_by_occupant and unauthorized_nonagricultural_structures_built_without_permission and lawful_eviction_for_changed_use and structures_remained_after_notice_to_remove

predicates.appeal_from_demolition_damages_decree: The authority appealed a decree that treated demolition of structures during an eviction as unlawful and awarded damages.
predicates.agricultural_land_held_by_occupant: An occupant held land for agricultural use.
predicates.unauthorized_nonagricultural_structures_: The occupant built structures for a non-agricultural use without obtaining the required permission.
predicates.lawful_eviction_for_changed_use: The occupant was lawfully evicted because the land’s use had been changed without permission.
predicates.structures_remained_after_notice_to_remo: The occupant did not remove the unauthorised structures after being required to do so.

issues.definition: When an authority appeals a decree concerning demolition and damages, and the occupant was lawfully evicted from agricultural land after building unauthorised non-agricultural structures and leaving them in place after notice, the authority may remove those structures without damages.
